allot.subject: Appointment
allot.text: In continuation to our earlier intimation dated 12th November, 2026 regarding appointment of Smt. Priyanka Agarwal as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent) of the Company w.e.f. 1st December, 2026. we wish to inform you that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has allotted DIN 12049700 to Smt. Priyanka Agarwal on 13th November, 2026.
